description: Current ferry service alerts: suspensions for typhoons or rough seas, cancelled or changed sailings, with the routes and ports they affect. Example: keyword "綠島"; or no input for every alert.

city.description: Leave out for the nationwide ferries (outlying islands, 小三通). For lines run by a county or city, its code: PenghuCounty, Kaohsiung, NewTaipei, Taipei, KinmenCounty (Penghu inter-island boats, 旗津 ferry, 淡水 blue highway, 金門 local ferries).

keyword.description: Only alerts whose title, route or port contains this, e.g. "綠島".

name: ferry_alerts
title: Ferry service alerts
